comparison.objective: Correct an underfilled or overfilled liquid dose to 10.000 ± 0.050 g and discard the pipette.
comparison.physical_skill: Balance-feedback dosing, aspiration, pressure-controlled dispensing, and bidirectional liquid correction.
comparison.success_condition: Final mass lies within tolerance, receiving beaker remains within its movement limit, and used pipette is released into the bin; detailed disposal tolerances are absent from the body.
comparison.reason: Precision liquid metering and disposal bear no central mechanical overlap with impact-driven tang fracture and solid-fragment recovery.
